newsitem.title: UK: Venezuela's 10-year bond due early next week -ING.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's 10-year bond due early next week -ING.

text.p: Venezuela's planned $315 million 10-year Eurobond will be launched early next week, lead manager ING Barings said on Friday.
"The bond will be launched on either Monday or Tuesday," a syndicate official at ING Barings said.
Bankers said price talk was around 260-290 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
On Thursday Standard & Poor's raised its rating of Venezuela's long-term foreign currency debt to B+ from B and has revised the rating outlook to stable from positive.
A B+ long-term foreign currency debt rating has been assigned to the republic's Brady debt, including New Money, Debt Conversion, Par, Discount, and Front-Loaded Interest Reduction bonds.
It also applies to Venezuela's new Eurobond, S&P said.
